impactframe.mod.name: The Ridiculous Impact Frame Mod
impactframe.configuration.title: Impact Frame settings
impactframe.configuration.enabled.toolti: Turn this off if you don't want any impact frames
impactframe.configuration.intensity.tool: How strong the effect looks, from 0% (invisible) to 100% (full strength)
How long to wait before another frame can play. 20 ticks is one second
impactframe.configuration.safeMode.toolt: Turns off color inversion and camera shake, lowers the contrast, and makes the FOV zoom gentler
impactframe.configuration.onAttack.toolt: Play a frame when you hit something
impactframe.configuration.onDamage.toolt: Play a frame when something hits you
impactframe.configuration.onBlockBreak.t: Play a frame when you break a block
impactframe.configuration.onBlockPlace.t: Play a frame when you place a block
impactframe.configuration.onExplosion.to: Play a frame when an explosion goes off near you
impactframe.configuration.onKill.tooltip: Play a frame when you kill an entity
impactframe.configuration.onLand.tooltip: Play a frame when you land after a fall
impactframe.configuration.soundEnabled.t: Play a short sound alongside the impact frame
impactframe.configuration.soundVolume.to: How loud the impact sound is, from 0% to 100%.
impactframe.configuration.onMace.tooltip: Give a mace the biggest frame. Turn this off if you'd rather use the crit or regular hit effect.
impactframe.configuration.serverFeatures: Turn this on for features that need The Ridiculous Impact Frame Mod on the server too, like freezing time for a moment. If it's off, everything stays client-side and nothing gets sent to the server.
impactframe.configuration.freezeOnImpact: Ask the server to pause time for a moment after an impact. You need 'Server stuff' turned on, and the server needs The Ridiculous Impact Frame Mod installed too.
impactframe.configuration.freezeTicks.to: How long the freeze lasts, the server may set a lower limit.
impactframe.configuration.lockMovement.t: Stops you from walking, jumping, or falling while time is frozen. You can still look around.
impactframe.gui.server.title: Server stuff
impactframe.gui.server.hint: optional, the server needs The Ridiculous Impact Frame Mod installed too.
impactframe.gui.server.status.none: You're not in a world right now.
impactframe.gui.server.status.yes: This server has The Ridiculous Impact Frame Mod, so time freeze is available.
impactframe.gui.server.status.no: This server doesn't have The Ridiculous Impact Frame Mod, so this stays client-side.
impactframe.gui.server.rules: The server can limit or turn this off in impactframe-common.toml
key.impactframe.open_settings: Open The Ridiculous Impact Frame Mod settings
impactframe.gui.title: The Ridiculous Impact Frame Mod presets
impactframe.gui.preset.minimal.descripti: Small frames for attacks and damage
impactframe.gui.preset.normal.descriptio: The Ridiculous Impact Frame Mod's normal experience
impactframe.gui.preset.love.description: Strong frames for pretty much everything that happens while you play
impactframe.gui.advanced.title: Pick your impact settings
impactframe.gui.advanced.hint: Trigger switches apply in Advanced; thresholds filter Normal, Minimal, and Advanced
impactframe.gui.keybindHint: You can rebind the key to access this menu in Options > Controls > Miscellaneous.
impactframe.gui.options.title: Visual & other settings
impactframe.gui.options.hint: Pick what shows up in your frames and how strong it is. Scroll down for more.
impactframe.configuration.directionalStr: Directional lines for swings and hits
Make the speed lines and shockwaves lean in the direction you swung or got hit instead of spreading out evenly
impactframe.configuration.zoomEnabled.to: Punch the FOV in for a moment when something hits
impactframe.configuration.zoomStrength.t: How hard the zoom hits. 1.0 is the original amount, 0 is no zoom
impactframe.configuration.halftone.toolt: Comic-style dots over the lighter parts of the frame. 0% turns them off
impactframe.configuration.onomatopoeia.t: Show words like BAM and CRACK on bigger impacts
impactframe.configuration.onomatopoeiaSc: How big the sound words are
impactframe.configuration.colorKeyedFram: Tint frames by what happened: red for damage, gold for crits, cyan for mace, orange for explosions, purple for kills
impactframe.configuration.letterbox.tool: Slide black bars in on mace smashes and boss kills
How much of the screen height each bar covers
impactframe.configuration.flashBudget.to: The most inverted frames that can show in one second. 0 never inverts
Use the depth buffer for sharper outlines. Turn this off if the frame looks wrong with a shader pack
impactframe.configuration.liteWithShader: Skips depth outlines on its own when Iris or Oculus is installed, since shader packs can change the depth buffer
